notes.title: Almost-10-Year Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
[h3]We meet again, People of Earth![/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5324722/6e4762093eb0e1523d939ffb4b7d2dc8928072b3.png[/img]

Hello!

We're updating the Oozi's adventure to keep it fresh and make sure it's in a healthy state for everyone to enjoy on both Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck devices. Here are the changes we've made:

[h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Limited the engine framerate to fix cases of broken game physics (e.g. moving platforms, conveyor belts, bomb-platforms).
[*] Improvements to Kid difficulty (e.g. bombs/fruits don't expire and you can jump while carrying them, triggering alarms no longer closes doors)
[*] Boss encounters balance improvements across all the difficulty levels.
[*] Improved support for Proton compatibility layer (Linux & Steam Deck).
[*] Fixes for controller vibration function not working.
[*] Fixes for the Cloud Save progress being reset.
[*] Fixes regarding crashes & launch errors.
[*] Other minor fixes & improvements.
[/list]In the case that you experience any visual stuttering on higher refresh rate displays, please make sure you are playing the game in the fullscreen mode (set in main menu options).

[h2]Switch Version Available Now![/h2]

For anyone interested, we've also just ported & launched Oozi for the [b]Nintendo Switch[/b], where it's titled [b]Super Cute Alien's Adventure[/b]. Feel free to check it out at [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/super-cute-aliens-adventure-switch/]My Nintendo Store[/url] & watch the [b]new trailer[/b]:

[previewyoutube=HcNtubV7nEs;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HcNtubV7nEs[/previewyoutube]
[h3]Thank you for all the support you've given us over the past 10 years ːheart_meː[/h3]

notes.title: Fury Unleashed - Our newest game now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5324722/295e4d6f14a774335999e37cf77c85ce00488604.png[/img]



Hi everyone! After [b]5 years[/b] of work, we've finally released the full version of our newest game - the combo-driven rogue-lite action-platformer - [b]Fury Unleashed[/b]!

Thanks to the support of our players over the span of the 3 years-long [b]Early Access[/b] period, we've managed to improve the game in every way and shape it into something we are proud of. Thanks to that, we are constantly being given positive reviews, both by the industry critics and from our players.

The game was created by combining inspiration from modern roguelite platformers, like [b]Dead Cells[/b] and [b]Rogue Legacy[/b], with nostalgic memories of old-school platformer shooters, like [b]Contra[/b] and [b]Metal Slug[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/465200/Fury_Unleashed/


[h2]Release Trailer[/h2]
In the same time as the Early Access graduation, Fury Unleashed was also released on [b]Nintendo Switch[/b], [b]PlayStation 4[/b], and [b]Xbox One[/b]. Here is our release trailer for the game:

[previewyoutube=XcOnFLxfau8;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]All You Need To Know[/h2]
Also, if you'd like to learn more about the game, here's a short video that talks about all the important details and should answer the most common questions you might have:  

[previewyoutube=KDBKSxV5mTk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1] Thank you for your support![/h1]

We'd like to remind you, that our studio is composed of just [b]5 people[/b], so all the feedback and help we keep receiving from our community is appreciated! Feel free to join us on our Awesome Games Studio [b]Discord Server[/b], to chat with us and the rest of the Awesome Community: https://discord.gg/m4JfXuS


Stay awesome!
Awesome Games Studio Team

notes.title: Badass Hero is now released on Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.badasshero.com/gifs/SteamEA_01.gif[/img]

Our new game Badass Hero was just released on Steam Early Access!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/465200

Badass Hero is a roquelite platformer shooter set in a comic book universe. The game features fast-paced hit and run gameplay, procedural generation of levels and random items that make every playthrough different! All in extremely polished, modern and high-resolution 2D art.

In Badass Hero you shoot enemies with various guns while avoiding projectiles, traps and obstacles. Collect ink from defeated enemies to upgrade your hero. Play dynamically and aggressively and take risks like a badass to get greater rewards! Stay focused at all times or you'll die sooner than you think. Become proficient with your character's skills and master each enemy to succeed!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5324722/a5c094d5b3f169ba6ad4e83d8b9e60988b953407.png[/img]

notes.title: Redesigned controls
notes.content: We are really sorry it took us almost three years to understand why Oozi's controls are bad. Unfortunately, we've got so used to them and lost all perspective over the course of development that we didn't see the obvious. But we've decided it's better late than never and redesigned them to be responsive as they should be on the release date. Today's update brings much better controls that will hopefully improve general feeling of the game.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Oozi: Earth Adventure
notes.content:
Oozi: Earth Adventure is Now Available on Steam!

Oozi: Earth Adventure is a classic 2D platformer with old school gameplay - no puzzles, no punishment, just 100% pure classic platforming fun! Its most prominent features are HD visuals and beautiful hand-drawn art, but despite its visual style, it’s a good fit for all kinds of gamers. The variety of difficulty levels – from Kid to Hardcore – allows everyone to enjoy the game regardless of their skill level. It tells the story of Oozi - an alien spaceship pilot who crashed on planet Earth, lost his space suit and needs to find his way home.
